entities.summary: Hanuman Singh Rathore is a noted former basketball player from India. He played for India in Asian Games, Commonwealth Games and at 1980 Olympics. He was awarded Arjuna Award in 1975. He studied at Military School, Ajmer. He represented Indian Railways in national tournaments. He is now employed with SAIL. Hanuman Singh was a athletes & competitors from Nagaur district (b. 1950, Nagaur district). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
